obs: "Such reasoning is a variant of the familiar principle of expressio unius est exclusio alterius: Congress' enactment of a provision defining the pre-emptive reach of a statute implies that matters beyond that reach are not pre-empted."
Geier v. American Honda Motor Co.
"Petitioners concede ... that the pre-emption provision, by itself, does not foreclose (through negative implication) any possibility of implied [conflict] pre-emption"
